contract.intent: GitHub binding (S7) — create issue/PR (F13); record action + result as a provenance artifact (AC6); confirm before destructive actions. Refuses to act without confirmation on destructive actions or fake success on failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue/PR creation (F13) via the GitHub API
Provenance artifact recorded per action (AC6): action, result, links
Destructive actions require confirmation before acting
No fake success: structured error on failure (fail-closed)
